contracts_rationale: Internal bug fix: no CLI, API or file-format interface changes; the fix changes how an existing private membership read degrades.
purpose_context: When the synthesis manifest cannot be read, reach-only membership now comes from the created-artifacts record, and when neither can be read every synthesized artifact linked from a directive is treated as reach-only, with a warning to the operator, so governance never fails open.
purpose_tldr: A corrupt synthesis manifest no longer delivers synthesized tactics or styleguides of an inactive directive
